fields.name: Instructions
fields.fieldText:
Instructions:

Please enter in all the required information to file an RMA request claim.

Credits will only be issued once the product is received and only in the quantities reported/confirmed received.

We will only accept whole units.

Do not mail loose pods, devices, or non-JUUL products.

If there are any discrepancies, your RMA will be at risk of being rejected.

A Juul reverse logistics specialist will reach out to you as soon as your RMA is approved. Thank you.
